spoilers.text: #ONEPIECE1189 I still remember when many people claimed that the StrawHats wouldn't make any major leaps in strength after Wano, and that the Beast Pirates were among the strongest around. But that’s not how shonen manga work. The Luffy who defeated Kaido is getting torn apart here. The Zoro who cut through King like butter is being easily overwhelmed by the Sommers. Sanji is on the verge of his next power-up. Shonen manga usually follow a similar pattern: the stronger the Straw Hats get, the stronger the villains become.
